oimr.options.host_only_tooltip: Only the Oneplayer/LAN host or server hallkeeper can shift these settings.
oimr.settings.title: One Inventory, Many Regrets
oimr.settings.slots_duplication_warning: Warning: Unlinking slot sharing can actively twifold things (meant behavior).
Leaving any hotbar or gear slot unshared keeps per-player things sundred and can actively bring about twifolding when players join, swap bands, or shift things. This is meant/planned behavior.
oimr.warning.affinity_reset: [OIMR] Unfit kinship worth spotted in settings (> 100%% or broken); kinship was set back to 100%%.
oimr.settings.affinity.tooltip: Steers how strongly spells, healing, knockback, harm, and Breathing are shared. At 100%%, all fellow deaths are linked; below 100%% unlinks must-happen deaths (for a bylaw at 50%%, 10 harm to A deals 5 to fellows). Does not shift shared stash slots.
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.n: Harm for 1 band heart: none (0%% kinship)
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.t: Shows how much harm one fellow must take (2 HP = 1 heart) for bandmates to take 1 full heart (2 HP) of shared harm.
oimr.settings.hunger_weight.tooltip: Per-player hunger tire out multiplier: (Weight * Action) / PartySize.
oimr.settings.xp_weight.tooltip: Per-player wisdom gain multiplier: (Weight * XP) / PartySize. Spending XP (galder, anvil) stays unchanged.
oimr.settings.sync_hotbar.tooltip: When on, all 9 hotbar slots (along with your main hand) are shared across the band.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.tooltip: When Hotbar sharing is OFF, shares Hotbar Slot 1 as an oned main-hand slot.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.coupled_too: Steered by Share Hotbar while Hotbar sharing is on (main hand brooks the chosen hotbar slot).
oimr.settings.sync_off_hand.tooltip: Shares the offhand slot across band fellows.
oimr.settings.sync_helmet.tooltip: Shares the helm armor slot across band fellows.
oimr.settings.sync_chestplate.tooltip: Shares the breastplate armor slot across band fellows.
oimr.settings.sync_leggings.tooltip: Shares the leggings armor slot across band fellows.
oimr.settings.sync_boots.tooltip: Shares the boots armor slot across band fellows.
oimr.settings.shared_knockback.tooltip: Spreads knockback across the band (scaled by Kinship) and deals back-shove when slapping a fellow.
oimr.settings.friendly_pets.tooltip: Stops owned or trusted tamebeasts of band fellows from striking fellowmates.
oimr.settings.exclude_creative.tooltip: When on, fellows in Shapywise mode are not slain by 100%% Kinship cascade death.
oimr.settings.wipe_creative.tooltip: When Shapywise fellows outlive cascade death, still wipe shared stash, gear, and XP.
oimr.settings.comunism.tooltip: Shows a shared even-sharing joke word when the band dies of hunger.
oimr.settings.shared_ender_pearl.tooltip: Farsteps the whole band to the landing stead whenever any fellow farsteps with an Ender Mergroat.
oimr.settings.shared_portals.tooltip: Farsteps the whole band together whenever any fellow walks through a Nether or End Doorway.
oimr.settings.underwater_muffle.tooltip: Lays a watery muffled sound strainer whenever you or a bonded fellow are underwater.
oimr.settings.shared_mob_sounds.tooltip: Echoes wight sounds heard by fellows with 1/N likelihood (N = band size), true bearing toward the wight, matched span, and loudness scaled by Kinship.
